# Vanagas Pen

> > Vanagas Pen crafts luxury handmade fountain pens and writing instruments with custom personalization, featuring artisan-designed collections inspired by natural materials and Mediterranean heritage.

Vanagas Pen is a Turkish luxury pen manufacturer specializing in handcrafted fountain pens, ballpoint pens, and roller pens. Founded by master craftsman Burak Şahin, the brand combines traditional pen-making techniques with premium materials including acrylic resin, natural woods, and marble to create one-of-a-kind writing instruments.

## Key Topics

- Handmade fountain pens
- Custom personalization
- Luxury writing instruments
- Jowo nib options
- Acrylic resin pens
- Natural wood pens
- Pen customization
- Artisan-crafted
- Mediterranean-inspired design
- Burak Şahin
- Nib customization
- Premium materials
- One-of-one designs
- Pen collecting

## Featured Collections

- [Halicarnassus Custom Collection](https://www.vanagaspen.com/custom-made): Custom fountain pen collection inspired by historical Bodrum heritage with personalization options
- [The Aegean Bloom](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/the-aegean-bloom-where-sea-meets-shore-in-perfect-harmony): Luxury fountain pen inspired by Mediterranean with Jowo #6 nib and coastal aesthetic
- [Canyon Grain](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/canyon-grain-carved-by-time-designed-for-the-moment): Canyon Grain luxury acrylic fountain pen with Jowo #6 nib and custom options
- [The Pebble Beach](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/the-pebble-beach-stillness-in-every-curve): Handcrafted acrylic fountain pen with Coastal Grey and Creamy White finishes
- [The Cloud Drift](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/the-cloud-drift-a-stillness-captured): Premium acrylic resin fountain pen with Jowo #6 nib and customization options

## Artisan Fountain Pens

- [Marble of Serenity](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/marble-of-serenity): Handcrafted luxury pen with marble design and extensive customization options
- [The Heart Remembers Red](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/the-heart-remembers-red): Crimson acrylic fountain pen with personalization and custom nib selection
- [Fire Echoes in the Light](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/fire-echoes-in-the-light-handmade-fountain-pen): Artisan epoxy resin fountain pen with Jowo #6 nib and bespoke customization
- [Fire Sleeps in the Dark](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/fire-sleeps-in-the-dark-handmade-fountain-pen): Handmade epoxy resin fountain pen with custom engraving capabilities
- [One of One - Code:0017](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/handmade-acrylic-fountain-pen-3): Unique handmade fountain pen by Burak with Iridium Point Germany nib
- [One of One - Code:0014](https://www.vanagaspen.com/product-page/handmade-acrylic-fountain-pen-2): One-of-one handmade fountain pen with custom nib personalization by Burak
